candidates.change_summary: Replaced assignment to owner with assignment to tx.origin so setOwner sets owner to tx.origin instead of the provided _owner.
Replaced assignment to owner with assignment to msg.sender so setOwner sets owner to the immediate caller rather than the provided _owner.
Deleted the assignment to owner so calling setOwner no longer changes owner.
Inserted a statement that sets owner to address(0) so setOwner resets owner to the zero address regardless of _owner.
Replaced require check to compare msg.sender to tx.origin, which can change who is authorized and thus whether setOwner succeeds, affecting owner after the call.
Replaced require check to compare msg.sender to address(0), making onlyOwner always fail and preventing setOwner from changing owner.
Replaced require check with a no-op (removed require) so onlyOwner no longer enforces and setOwner can be called by anyone, changing resulting owner.
